title: Fix Demonstrator Focus Transition Flicker
description: Clicking a demonstrator app card (e.g. top-right) scrolls the main grid correctly but the transform flickers back and forth during the transition because a CSS transform transition fights the rAF easing loop. Make focus and overview scrolling a single smooth drive.
summary:
## Summary
Fixed the Entwerfen-mit-Bestand demonstrator focus transition flicker (e.g. clicking the top-right Aggregator card). The grid scroll now moves in one smooth direction with no back-and-forth.

### Root cause
Two animation systems owned the same `transform`:
1. A rAF exponential follow / lerp loop updating `scrollOffset` every frame
2. A CSS `transition: transform 500ms` that turned on when `focusedId` was set

Every JS frame retargeted the CSS transition, so the main window visibly oscillated. A secondary glitch: glide ease used the rAF timestamp against a `performance.now()` start time, so `t` could go slightly negative and lerp backward for one frame.

### Fix
- Removed the focus-time CSS transform transition
- Single scroll drive: free-pan **follow** (exponential) vs programmatic **glide** (500ms cubic ease-in-out) for hover pin / focus
- Epoch-guarded `setScrollOffset` so stale follow paints cannot land after a glide starts
- Clamp glide `t` to `[0,1]` and clock glide with `performance.now()`

### Verification
- Math probe: glide to top-right is monotonic (`🧪scroll-drive-math.json`)
- Playwright on :6029: Aggregator focus has 0 reverse steps, 0 CSS transform duration, ends at `-200vw` (`🧪focus-smooth-probe.json`)
- Multi-pane hover+click Aggregator / Generator / Verfolgen: 0 reverse steps (`🧪multi-focus-probe.json`)

### Files
- `♻️mit-bestand/🧺️demonstrator/📦️index.tsx`
